instructions:
VocalStack transcribes and translates recorded or live audio and video in about 100 languages, with speaker labels.
Recorded audio: create_transcription (a link or a file) returns a transcriptionId at once; get_transcription with waitS waits for it and reads the text, in any language with lang.
Find: list_transcriptions (ids, newest first); search_transcriptions (mode words for words or names, meaning for a question).
One transcription: get_summary; rename_speaker; set_cloned_voices; delete_transcription (to the trash, restorable in the Dashboard).
Live streams: start_broadcast, then get_transcription while it runs, stop_broadcast to end it; list_broadcasts shows them; delete_broadcast removes one.
People: list_speakers, save_speaker (voice cloned only with the person's consent), rename_speaker, set_cloned_voices with speakerId, delete_speaker.
Only transcription is billed; everything else, and listening, is free. Retry a start with the same idempotencyKey.
Errors are results with isError true: error, message, retryable, and retryAfterS or topUpUrl when they apply.

tools.name: create_transcription
tools.title: Create a transcription
tools.description:
Start transcribing a finished recording, from a public link or a file sent inline; returns a transcriptionId at once, before any text.
Use: audio or video that has ended (a file, podcast episode, YouTube video or public post). A stream playing now: start_broadcast. The result: get_transcription with waitS, no polling needed.
List price: $0.20 an hour of audio, billed per second transcribed; Pay as you go bills at least 5 minutes per transcription. Each call is a new, billed transcription unless it repeats an idempotencyKey; a refused call costs nothing; summary and shareLink are free.
New transcriptions an hour per account: 10 on Pay as you go, 100 on Premium.
Transcriptions running at once per account: 5 on Pay as you go, 50 on Premium; more wait their turn instead of failing.
Returns: transcriptionId, state (queued, fetching, transcribing, then done, failed or stopped), progress, shareUrl when shareLink is true, replayed true for a repeated key.
Errors: invalid_options (neither or both of url and fileBase64, not a public http(s) link, bad base64, too large), invalid_audio (empty file), idempotency_key_reused, insufficient_credit (with topUpUrl), quota_exceeded, rate_limited (with retryAfterS). A source that cannot be read ends in state failed, with error.

endS.description: Transcribe only up to this second (default: the end), at least 0.5 s after startS.

fileBase64.description: The whole file in standard base64 (a data: URL prefix and line breaks are accepted), at most 10 MiB decoded; for a larger file give url instead. mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, webm and other common formats; the format is read from the file. Needs filename.

filename.description: With fileBase64 only: the file's name with its extension, also the default display name.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string of visible ASCII. Retrying with the same key and the same arguments within 24 h returns the first result (with replayed true) and nothing is created or billed twice; the same key with other arguments is refused.

mimeType.description: With fileBase64 only, optional: the file's media type when known.

name.description: Display name shown in lists and on the share page. Defaults to the file name or the link.

shareLink.description: Make a public link anyone can open to read the transcript without signing in (shareUrl in the result). Off: it stays private to this account.

speakerLabels.description: auto labels lines once a second speaker is heard, on labels every line, off none. Recordings under a minute are never labelled.

spokenLanguage.description: Code of the language spoken, e.g. en, ro, es. Omit to detect it (recordings that switch language are handled too); set it for better accuracy on short or noisy audio.

startS.description: Transcribe only from this second (default: the start). Only the part transcribed is billed: startS 90 and endS 600 bill 8.5 minutes.

summary.description: Also write a title and summary when it is done, at no extra cost (get_summary reads it). Never for recordings under a minute.

url.description: Public http(s) link to the recording: an audio or video file, a YouTube video, or a public post on Twitch, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo, Dailymotion, TikTok, X, SoundCloud, Kick, Mixcloud, Bandcamp, LinkedIn, TED, Internet Archive, Streamable, Odysee, Niconico, VK, BitChute, Wistia, Vidyard, Kaltura, JW Player, Pinterest, Bluesky, Google Drive, Dropbox, Spreaker, iHeartRadio, Audioboom, CNN or Loom. It must open without signing in and must not be a live stream. Give either url or fileBase64, not both.

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.title: Read a transcription
tools.description:
Read one transcription's status and text, with timestamps and speakers: as it was spoken or translated, at once or after waiting for it to finish.
Use: after create_transcription (waitS saves polling), or any time during a live transcription for the text so far. An overview: get_summary. Finding a passage: search_transcriptions.
Behaviour: free. A wait ends as soon as the work does, and sends progress notifications when the client gives a progress token. lang needs a finished transcription; the first call in a new language can take up to a minute on a long one, later pages are quick. Page with offset = nextOffset.
Returns: status (state, progress, error when failed, shareUrl when it has a public link: made with create_transcription's shareLink, or in the Dashboard), timedOut when waitS was set, then segmentCount, partial while text is still coming, text or segments, nextOffset when more remain, and lang and translated with lang. A wait that runs out with lang set returns the status only.
Errors: not_found; invalid_state for lang before it is finished; invalid_options for an unsupported lang or includeWords with lang; rate_limited when waitS is set and 4 waits are already open for this key (8 for the account).

format.description: text: one string, a line per segment as "[mm:ss] Speaker 1: words", for reading and quoting; segments: timed lines (start, end, text, speakerNumber, speakerName), for subtitles and exact times; none: status only (with waitS: wait without reading).

includeWords.description: With format segments and no lang: also each word with its start and end second. It makes the answer several times larger, so ask for a narrow page (e.g. limit 50).

lang.description: Code of a language to read the whole text in, one of about 100 (e.g. es, de, ja): the transcription must be finished (state done, or a stopped live one). The language already spoken returns the original with translated false. Omit for the original.

limit.description: Most segments in one call. When more are left the result has nextOffset.

offset.description: Index of the first segment to return (0, the start, by default). To page, pass the nextOffset the previous call returned.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast.

waitS.description: Seconds to wait for a file or link transcription to finish before answering, 0 to 60 (0, the default: answer at once). Returns as soon as it ends; timedOut true means it is still running, so call again. Keep it under your client's call timeout. A live transcription never waits.

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.title: List transcriptions
tools.description:
List this account's transcriptions, newest first, a page at a time: files, links and live ones, including those broadcasts recorded.
Use: to find a transcriptionId or see what exists. What was said: search_transcriptions. Broadcasts: list_broadcasts.
Behaviour: free. lifecycle archived lists the trash: deleted transcriptions, which the VocalStack Dashboard can restore for 30 days. A cursor this tool did not give out is refused.
Returns: transcriptions (transcriptionId, name, createdAt, kind file or live, state, durationS and title when known, broadcastId for a broadcast's), and nextCursor while more remain. None: an empty list.
Errors: invalid_options for an unknown cursor.

cursor.description: Omit for the first page (the newest). For the next page, pass the previous call's nextCursor unchanged, with the same lifecycle.

lifecycle.description: Which transcriptions: active those in use, archived those in the trash, all both.

tools.name: search_transcriptions
tools.title: Search transcriptions
tools.description:
Find what was said across this account's transcriptions, or in one: the lines with given words or a name (mode words), or the passages that answer a question (mode meaning).
Use: words when you know what was said; meaning for a question or topic, in any language. Text around a hit: get_transcription with offset. One transcription's overview: get_summary.
Behaviour: free; no paging. words ranks whole words first, then close spellings, then newest, and searches the query's English translation too. meaning returns up to 10 passages, closest first. Searches by meaning an hour per account: 60 on Pay as you go, no limit on Premium.
Returns: words: query, queryEn, hits (transcriptionId, name, mediaStart in seconds, speaker, text, score, live, recordedAt, rendered with lang). meaning: query, state (ready, or unavailable or off when it cannot run), passages (transcriptionId, name, mediaStart, mediaEnd, text, similarity 0 to 1, live), searchesLeftThisHour when capped. Cite the transcription and second. No match: an empty list.
Errors: not_found for an unknown transcriptionId; invalid_options for lang or limit with mode meaning; rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past the hourly searches by meaning.

lang.description: mode words only, optional language code: each hit also comes back translated into it, as rendered. It never changes what matches.

limit.description: mode words only: most lines to return, best first. There is no next page: narrow the query or set transcriptionId.

mode.description: words: the lines where these words or a close spelling were said ("presupuesto" also finds "budget"). meaning: the passages closest in meaning, even with none of the words.

query.description: mode words: words, a phrase or a name that was said. mode meaning: a question or topic in plain words; a full question works better than one keyword. Any language.
examples: What did they decide about hiring?

transcriptionId.description: Search only this transcription (a transcriptionId from list_transcriptions or create_transcription). Omit to search the whole account.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.title: Get a summary
tools.description:
Get the title and summary of a finished transcription, writing one the first time if it has none.
Use: for an overview. Full text, or the whole text in another language: get_transcription. A specific question: search_transcriptions with mode meaning.
Arguments: transcriptionId of a finished transcription (state done, or a stopped live one), from create_transcription, list_transcriptions or search_transcriptions. lang is optional, a language code such as fr: it translates only when the transcription was made with summary translations on and lang differs from the language the summary is in; otherwise the original comes back, without lang in the result.
Behaviour: free. Writing a first summary needs the write scope and keeps it for later calls; reading an existing one needs read only.
Returns: state ready with title and summary (and lang when translated); pending while it is written or the transcription still runs (call again in a few seconds); not_requested for recordings under a minute; unavailable when the transcription failed.
Errors: not_found; forbidden when a summary must be written and the key is read-only.

lang.description: Optional language code for the title and summary, honoured when the transcription was made with summary translations on; otherwise the original comes back without lang.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast.

tools.name: rename_speaker
tools.title: Rename a speaker
tools.description:
Name or rename a speaker: one person in one transcription, so its transcript shows the name instead of "Speaker N", or a saved speaker, everywhere they are recognised.
Use: labelling who spoke here, or correcting a saved speaker's name. To recognise the person in later transcriptions too: save_speaker (it also names them here). Saved speakers: list_speakers.
Arguments: give exactly one of transcriptionId with speaker (the number in "Speaker 2" from get_transcription, not a name or an id) or speakerId (from list_speakers). name is trimmed; in a transcription it is cut to 80 characters and an empty name undoes it; a saved speaker's name is 1 to 60 characters. Calling again replaces the name.
Behaviour: free and reversible; in a transcription it applies to that person in every recording of it, and listeners following it live see it at once. The person's speaker number never changes. Renaming a saved speaker changes nothing else about them (fingerprint, consent, cloned voice).
Returns: transcriptionId, speaker, name (null when cleared); or, with speakerId, speakerId and name.
Errors: invalid_options for both or neither kind of target, or a saved speaker's name out of 1 to 60; not_found for an unknown transcription, speaker number or speakerId; forbidden for a read-only key.

name.description: The name to show instead of "Speaker N", trimmed: 1 to 80 characters in one transcription (longer is cut; an empty string clears it back to "Speaker N"), 1 to 60 for a saved speaker (never empty).

speaker.description: With transcriptionId: the N of "Speaker N" in get_transcription's text, or speakerNumber in its segments; it stays the same after naming.

speakerId.description: Instead of transcriptionId and speaker: a saved speaker's id (id in list_speakers, or speakerId from save_speaker), renamed everywhere they are recognised.

transcriptionId.description: With speaker: the transcription the speaker is in (from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast). Leave out with speakerId.

tools.name: delete_transcription
tools.title: Delete a transcription
tools.description:
Move a transcription to the trash, with its recordings, transcript, translations and summary; its share links stop working.
Use: to remove one. For 30 days it can be restored unchanged from the trash in the VocalStack Dashboard (list_transcriptions with lifecycle archived lists it); after that it is erased for good. Saved speakers stay (delete_speaker). A broadcast itself: delete_broadcast.
Behaviour: a file or link still being transcribed is stopped first and keeps its text so far, billed only for what was transcribed; restoring does not resume it. A live one must be stopped first (stop_broadcast).
Returns: transcriptionId, name, deleted, deletedAt, restorableUntil.
Errors: invalid_state while recording live or when locked; not_found; forbidden for a read-only key.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from list_transcriptions or create_transcription.

tools.name: set_cloned_voices
tools.title: Turn cloned voices on or off
tools.description:
Turn cloned voices on or off for spoken translations: for one transcription, or for one saved speaker everywhere they are recognised.
On: the speaker's translated words are read in that speaker's own cloned voice, never anyone else's; a speaker without a usable clone gets a stock voice. Off: stock voices. Voices are chosen by VocalStack; this is the only voice choice.
Arguments: give exactly one of transcriptionId (every speaker in it) or speakerId (a saved speaker, from list_speakers). on is required; consent must be true to turn on.
Consent: turning on records, with your account and the time, that everyone speaking (or that saved speaker) agreed. For a transcription it releases its clones waiting for consent; speakers who refused are never cloned. For a saved speaker saved without consent it starts their clone from their stored sample. Off keeps the saved speaker's fingerprint, consent and clone, only unused; to erase the clone and their samples: delete_speaker.
Behaviour: free and reversible; lines read aloud after the change use the new setting.
Returns: transcriptionId, name, clonedVoices; or, with speakerId, speakerId, name, consent, clonedVoice, and voiceState (training, then ready) when cloned.
Errors: invalid_options for on without consent or both or neither target; invalid_state for a deleted transcription, a speaker who refused, or one with no stored sample to clone from; not_found; forbidden for a read-only key.

consent.description: Must be true to turn cloned voices on: confirms everyone speaking (with speakerId: that person) agreed to have their voice cloned. Recorded with your account and the time. Not needed to turn them off.

on.description: true: translations of the speaker's own words are read in their own cloned voice; false (the default for a transcription): stock voices.

speakerId.description: Instead of transcriptionId, for one saved speaker everywhere they are recognised: id in list_speakers, or speakerId from save_speaker.

transcriptionId.description: For one transcription's spoken translations: a transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast. Leave out with speakerId.

annotations.title: Turn cloned voices on or off

tools.name: list_speakers
tools.title: List saved speakers
tools.description:
List the speakers this account has saved: people recognised by name in every new transcription.
Use: to see who is known or find a speakerId for delete_speaker. Save one: save_speaker. Names inside one transcription come from get_transcription and are set with rename_speaker, which saves no one.
Behaviour: free; no paging.
Returns: speakers, newest first, each with id, name, gender when known, cloned (their voice was cloned, with consent, to read translations of their own words) and, when cloned, voiceReady. None saved: an empty list.

tools.name: save_speaker
tools.title: Save a speaker
tools.description:
Save one speaker of a transcription to the account's saved speakers, so later transcriptions recognise and name them; their own speech in this transcription is the sample.
Use: remembering a person across transcriptions. This transcription only: rename_speaker. Who is saved: list_speakers. Remove: delete_speaker.
Arguments: transcriptionId and speaker point at one person: speaker is the number in "Speaker 2" from get_transcription, who must have spoken (a live transcription can still be running). name is 1 to 60 characters, trimmed; renaming later: rename_speaker with speakerId. consent is true only when that person agreed to be cloned; leaving it out or false keeps only their fingerprint.
Behaviour: free; also names them in this transcription. Each call saves a new speaker, so check list_speakers first. Without consent only a voice fingerprint is kept; with it the voice is cloned too, recorded with your account and the time.
Returns: speakerId, name, consent (granted or pending), cloned, voiceState (training, then ready) when cloned.
Errors: not_found for an unknown transcription or speaker number; invalid_options for too little speech of them (the message says how much there is); forbidden for a read-only key.

consent.description: true only when this person agreed to have their voice cloned: it is then cloned too, from their own speech in this transcription, so translations of their words can be read in their voice. false: only their fingerprint is saved. Never set it without the person's agreement.

name.description: The person's name, shown in this and later transcriptions.

speaker.description: The N of "Speaker N" in get_transcription's text, or speakerNumber in its segments. Works while a live transcription is still running.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast.

tools.name: delete_speaker
tools.title: Delete a saved speaker
tools.description:
Delete a saved speaker for good: their name, fingerprint, stored sample and any cloned voice are erased at once and cannot be restored.
Use: the person should no longer be recognised, or asked for their voice to be removed. A name inside one transcription: rename_speaker.
Arguments: speakerId is a saved speaker's id, the id field of list_speakers or the speakerId save_speaker returned; not a speaker number ("Speaker 2") and not a transcriptionId. To unname someone in one transcription instead: rename_speaker with an empty name.
Behaviour: free. Transcripts keep every line they spoke; lines labelled with their saved name go back to "Speaker N".
Returns: speakerId, deleted true.
Errors: not_found for an unknown or already deleted id; forbidden for a read-only key.

speakerId.description: A saved speaker's id: id in list_speakers, or speakerId from save_speaker.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description:
List this account's broadcasts, or get one in detail. A broadcast is a public link where listeners follow a live transcription in their own language.
Use: to find a broadcastId for start_broadcast, stop_broadcast or delete_broadcast, see which are on air, or (with broadcastId) a broadcast's recorded transcriptions and streams. Text: get_transcription; they also appear in list_transcriptions.
Behaviour: free; most recently updated first, up to 500 per lifecycle, no paging.
Returns: broadcasts (broadcastId, name, link, access, onAir, listenersNow, lastRecordedAt once it has recorded, archived for one in the trash; while on air transcriptionId, state, onAirSince). With broadcastId, one item that adds transcriptions (up to 20: transcriptionId, name, recording, lastRecordedAt) and streams (name, url). None: an empty list.
Errors: not_found for an unknown broadcastId.

broadcastId.description: Optional: return only this broadcast, in detail (its recorded transcriptions and stream addresses too). lifecycle is then ignored.

lifecycle.description: Which broadcasts: active those in use, archived those in the trash, all both.

tools.name: start_broadcast
tools.title: Start a broadcast
tools.description:
Start live transcription and translation of a stream playing now, on a public link listeners open in their own language.
Use: a stream playing now. A recording that has ended: create_transcription. Reading it while it runs: get_transcription.
Arguments: streamUrl must be live when called; the same streamUrl on the same broadcast reuses its stream. broadcastId (from list_broadcasts) reruns an existing broadcast on its old link, and then name is ignored; without it a new broadcast is made, named name or the stream's host. spokenLanguage is a code like en (omit to detect). spokenTranslations true adds audio of each translation. idempotencyKey: any string you choose, reused only to retry this same call.
List price: $0.60 an hour while it runs, billed per second; Pay as you go bills at least 5 minutes per transcription. Listeners and translations are free. It runs until stop_broadcast or the stream ends.
Transcriptions running at once per account: 5 on Pay as you go, 50 on Premium; past that a start is refused with quota_exceeded.
Behaviour: each call starts a new run unless it repeats an idempotencyKey; omitting broadcastId makes a new broadcast with a new link.
Returns: broadcastId, name, link (anyone who opens it reads, or with spokenTranslations also hears, the stream in their language), transcriptionId, state.
Errors: invalid_state (with link) when already on air, invalid_options for a non-http(s) address, insufficient_credit (with topUpUrl), quota_exceeded, not_found for an unknown broadcastId, forbidden for a key without the write and recordings:publish scopes.

broadcastId.description: Optional: run it on this existing broadcast (from list_broadcasts), so its listeners' link stays the same. Omit to make a new broadcast with a new link.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string of visible ASCII. Retrying with the same key and the same arguments within 24 h returns the first result (with replayed true) and nothing is started twice; the same key with other arguments is refused.

name.description: Name of a new broadcast, shown to listeners. Defaults to the stream's host. Ignored with broadcastId.

spokenLanguage.description: Code of the language spoken, e.g. en, es. Omit to detect it.

spokenTranslations.description: Also read each translation aloud, so listeners can hear it in their language as well as read it. Listening stays free.

streamUrl.description: http(s) address of a stream playing now: a YouTube live, an internet radio station, an HLS (.m3u8) or Icecast stream. A recording that has ended goes to create_transcription instead.

tools.name: stop_broadcast
tools.title: Stop a broadcast
tools.description:
Stop the live transcription a broadcast is running, which also stops its billing.
Use: when the event is over. To remove the transcript afterwards: delete_transcription; the broadcast and its link: delete_broadcast.
Arguments: broadcastId of a broadcast on air: from start_broadcast's result, or list_broadcasts (onAir true); not the transcriptionId. A second call is refused with invalid_state and changes nothing, so a retry is safe.
Behaviour: free. The transcript is kept (get_transcription and get_summary work on it once state is done); the broadcastId and its link stay, ready for the next start_broadcast.
Returns: the stopped transcription's status (transcriptionId, name, kind live, state finishing then done, startedAt, endedAt, durationS) with broadcastId and link.
Errors: invalid_state when not on air, not_found for an unknown broadcastId, forbidden for a key without the recordings:publish scope.

broadcastId.description: A broadcastId from list_broadcasts or start_broadcast.

tools.name: delete_broadcast
tools.title: Delete a broadcast
tools.description:
Move a broadcast to the trash: its public link and stream addresses stop working for listeners.
Use: a broadcast that will not run again. For 30 days it can be restored from the trash in the VocalStack Dashboard (list_broadcasts with lifecycle archived lists it); after that the broadcast is erased for good. Ending a live run: stop_broadcast.
Arguments: broadcastId from list_broadcasts or start_broadcast; not a transcriptionId.
Behaviour: free. A broadcast on air is refused: stop it first (stop_broadcast). The transcriptions it recorded are not deleted: while it is in the trash they leave list_transcriptions with it, get_transcription still reads them by id, and delete_transcription deletes one. Deleting again changes nothing.
Returns: broadcastId, name, deleted true, deletedAt, restorableUntil.
Errors: invalid_state while on air; not_found for an unknown broadcastId; forbidden for a read-only key.

broadcastId.description: A broadcastId from list_broadcasts or start_broadcast, of a broadcast that is not on air.
